name: Trypio
description: An absolute classic from the early generations. Trypio features a massive, distinctive outer propeller ring designed to catch updrafts and alter air currents inside the stadium, turning raw wind into survival energy.

ability.name: Updraft Glide
ability.description: Trypio's massive propeller layer generates constant lift. Reduces all incoming impact damage by 25, converts friction into stability, and recovers 1 Stamina per turn passively.

chain._note: special_move heal – trigger from on_special (engine reads chain from ability)

special_move.name: Tornado Glide
special_move.description: Creates a localized vortex that aggressively destabilizes the opponent while trapping air currents to restore Trypio's own rotation.
flavour_texts: 🌪️ **Tornado Glide** — The massive propeller whips up a devastating vortex!
🌀 The enemy loses 4 Stamina while Trypio recovers 90 HP!
